description: The shared gap-class taxonomy the SDK status classifiers agree on. `derive_status` (NodeStatus: built/thin/spec/deprecated) and det-req's `fr_health` (n/a/skipped/unknown/on_track) measure different axes but both project onto one gap-class taxonomy. Each fixture pins that both classifiers map onto the SAME gap_class. This file is self-contained (no SDK import required): a second implementation (dev-os det-req-kit `extract.py`, Studio `req-health.mjs`) runs these inputs through its own `derive_status`/`fr_health` and asserts the recorded native output and the same gap_class via the maps below.
note_on_unknown: fr_health's `unknown` (a done-claim without strong evidence) has no derive_status counterpart, so it is not an agreement class — the contract covers grounded/gap/excluded where the two classifiers DO agree.
